[[Eye of the North]] | render = [[Image:Boss_Key.jpg|150px]] }} Many Eye of the North [[Dungeon]]s have a [[Boss Lock]] that requires a [[Boss Key]] to open. These keys will drop from a specific boss when killed. The location of the boss with the key and the corresponding lock it opens are indicated by red icons on the mini-map if an [[Area Map]] or [[Dungeon Map]] have been used. ==Acquisition== *[[Depths of Tyria]] **[[Bogroot Growths]] Level 2: [[Gokir Patriarch|Gokir]] or [[Ophil Patriarch|Ophil]] Patriarch **[[Catacombs of Kathandrax]] Level 3: [[Flame Djinn]] **[[Cathedral of Flames]] Level 3: [[Murakai's Steward]] **[[Darkrime Delves]] Level 1: [[Havok-kin]]. Level 2: [[Grelk Icelash]] **[[Forsaken Tunnels]] Level 3: On the ground in the northwest **[[Ooze Pit]]: [[Gloop]] **[[Rragar's Menagerie]] Level 2: [[Rragar Maneater]]. Level 3: [[Flesheater]] **[[Secret Lair of the Snowmen]]: [[Freezie]] **[[Tunnels of the Forsaken]] Level 3: [[Enraged Phantom]] **[[Vloxen Excavations]] Level 1: [[Taskmaster Durgon]]. Level 3: [[Sotanaht the Tomb Guardian]] ==Notes== *One open inventory slot is required to pick up the boss key, although it doesn't actually show up in your inventory. *Once a boss key is acquired, the words "Boss Key retrieved" and a red boss key icon will appear on the right side of the UI's Mission Goals overlay. *Any party member can use the key on the lock for which it is required, regardless of who picked it up. *See also: [[Dungeon Key]] {{anomaly|The message ''Boss Key retrieved'' and the image of the key cannot be switched off even if you have cleared all the interface options on the Options pane (F11).}}
